scope: Extend generated DICTIONARYVAR OBJECTS transaction evidence across all seven admitted DXF writer revisions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored graph generated during each test run
source.profile: One NOD entry targets a DICTIONARY containing one DICTIONARYVAR with an exact owner link, schema 0, and a generated string value.

implementation.method: For each version and encoding, warm the codec, calibrate a complete write, inject std::bad_alloc at each measured callback allocation, require unchanged destination sentinel and caller graph, retry on the same codec, compare retry bytes with clean output, and freshly read back the NOD-to-DICTIONARY-to-DICTIONARYVAR graph.

validation.directControl: build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_dictionaryvar_objects_version_allocation_tests build-gcc/tests/dictionaryvar-objects-version-allocation-scratch: PASS; seven revisions each sweep ASCII and Binary allocation offsets

limitations: Generated DXF allocation rollback, retry, and typed readback evidence only; this does not establish producer-profile breadth or native consumer semantics.
One generated dictionary/DICTIONARYVAR graph and field profile is tested per version; other dictionary topologies and independent producer behavior remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
